body:
Since the state is shared between all children of the InstantSearch component, different components _can_ read and update the same state key. For instance, you can have two Pagination components at the same time. However, the format of their state should be normalized. In the case of NumericRefinementList and InputRange, I think it makes sense to pick one format for both.

However, for widgets that control the same refinement but have incompatible state, then maybe only one of those widgets should have a state at any point in time. I don't know of any such widget, so I'll use NumericRefinementList and InputRange as an example: when you select a value in a NumericRefinementList, the InputRange's state would get cleared, and vice versa. That would also mean using different state keys for both widgets.
